big_case.notes: Third emergency trip to the Court on the same nationwide third-country-removal policy, now with the Court treating the application as a cert petition, granting it, and setting December 2026 argument on district-court jurisdiction over such claims, whether 1252(f)(1) bars classwide declaratory relief and APA vacatur (a remedies question Biden v. Texas left open), and the legality of the Guidance under 1231(b), due process, and FARRA/CAT. Stakes: thousands of removals, torture/persecution protections, foreign relations, and the reach of classwide remedies against the executive. Formed from the record and outcome, not from the candidates' scores.
